function_summary: 1-V 2.5-mW 5.2-GHz Frequency Divider in a 0.35-m CMOS Process: A 1-V low-power high-speed dynamic-loading frequency divider is proposed using novel D flip-flops with a common-gate topology and with a single clock phase.
